dedupe_keys.name: central america percentage of 3g telephony coverage by department and municipality accion contra el hambre and gis4tech 2020

description: This dataset gives the percentage of 3G mobile telephony coverage for El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras and Nicaragua, categorised by country, department and municipality, for 2020. It was prepared by Action Against Hunger with the geographic analysis company GIS4tech from GSMA coverage data, and forms part of the PREDISAN platform for food security and disaster risk analysis in the Central American Dry Corridor. The table is a single CSV of about 54 KB, updated on the Humanitarian Data Exchange in April 2025. Coverage: El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras and Nicaragua, by municipality. Format and access: CSV download from the Humanitarian Data Exchange, free under CC BY. Caveats: derived from operator coverage maps collected by the GSMA, which model outdoor coverage; the share is likely by area or population, which the notes do not say; 3G only, with no 4G; a single year. Simulation uses: municipal mobile coverage for reach of early warning, cash transfer and emergency communication in drought and hurricane scenarios in Central America. Related records: the Guinea localities covered by telecom networks is a comparable humanitarian coverage table; the ITU ICT statistics give national series; the LAC-IX survey and map covers exchange points in the region.
